preserved_premises.generator: H=pi*d^T-diag(d); A=K+wH; K/pi/destruction fixed within each certificate family.
preserved_premises.certificate_domain: Entire certified w box, every start time, zero-mass residual and nonexpansive short remainders. Bind q/tau to the full A family. Nominal K rho is not a full A certificate.
preserved_premises.kernel: h(age)=q^floor(age/tau), h(0)=1 including q=0 arithmetic controls.
preserved_premises.scalar: E=abs(eta), coarse l1=4E; fixed c>=0 and signed d_c over the certified horizon; c is the comparison coupling.
preserved_premises.forcing: Whole fine/coarse-source/state-domain bound functions; endpoint/sample interpolation alone is not a bound certificate.
preserved_premises.history: R forcing memory remains global from original t0 across observations, source partitions, restarts and publication checkpoints.
preserved_premises.closed_cells: Whole-cell bounds include attained extrema and right-endpoint left-limit suprema. Endpoint drawing connectors are not whole-cell certificates.
preserved_premises.lower: Raw lower endpoints bound the chosen-rational-q ideal comparison, not physical error.
preserved_premises.caps: R13 has no generic cap adapter. Historical R10/R11 caps retain their exact source/state/clock/closed-cell identity and cannot be transferred to a new source by label.
preserved_premises.native_v: UNSPECIFIED; actual new source labels must be recorded separately without rewriting the native fixture.
preserved_premises.methods: TIQM and SQM remain distinct; reactive and HD-preserving excitation channels remain distinct.
preserved_premises.conventions: Metric(-,+,+,+); retain c,hbar,kB where physically relevant; no silent density, clock or rate-unit conversion.

Compare K/pi/d/w-family identity with the source of the all-starts full-A q/tau certificate. A changed family needs its own proof contract.
Bind whole-domain g_r/g_e bound functions and canonical forcing SHA, source/state/clock identity; record whether supplied functions meet existing affine input class.
Check all current finite-domain conditions jointly; identify any required cap adapter or input-class extension before proposing execution.
Write a concrete new-unit proof/code/resource contract and freeze identities before any new scientific execution; keep zero allowance until separately authorized.

rejection_cases: Missing bytes or a DOI/abstract/summary supplied as though it were a numeric reactive array.
Hash, reaction direction, method, state map or matrix orientation mismatch.
Inferring v=0 or zero rate from missing labels/entries.
Relabeling TIQM/SQM or excitation data as reactive data.
Missing density/clock units or an unproved clock conversion.
Transplanting nominal K rho or an old full-A certificate onto a changed family.
Treating ARITHMETIC_CONTROL_PREMISE q=0 as a realized physical full-A certificate.
Using samples or endpoint plots as whole-source/state-domain forcing or whole-cell evidence.
Stale canonical forcing hash after changing a forcing cell, state order or clock.
Singletonstates1 with R0>0 or any positive g_r endpoint.
Floats/bools/nulls as exact scalars, negative affine endpoints, nonincreasing/mismatched clocks or any finite bound exceeded.
Resetting R forcing memory at an observation/checkpoint.
Reusing historical caps on a new source/state/clock or issuing production before binding/admission.
input_binding_first.failure_semantics: Keep the artifact/provenance and the exact missing or inconsistent field. A rejected binding does not establish a physical impossibility or global data absence.

no_input_future_candidate.candidate_topic: Piecewise-quadratic whole-domain forcing with certified cubic convolution extrema and positive exponential propagation.
no_input_future_candidate.proposed_input_class: Exact rational source/observation knots; per-cell quadratic bound functions with a declared whole-domain source premise and an explicit nonnegativity certificate, for example nonnegative degree2 Bernstein coefficients. Keep the same fixed full-A family, q/tau, c/d_c and initial semantics.
no_input_future_candidate.distinct_from_R13: R13 affine forcing produces quadratic R pieces with rational vertices. Quadratic forcing would require a cubic piece construction and derivative-quadratic extrema, which can have irrational algebraic roots. The R13 vertex and Bernstein2 proofs/code do not automatically cover that class.
proof_obligations: Derive an exact overlap-moment/primitive identity for quadratic forcing and show the polynomial degree and event topology on each base cell.

Certify all derivative roots, multiplicities, root ordering, endpoint coincidences and the identically-zero derivative case. Represent irrational roots by exact algebraic data or certified rational isolating intervals.
Prove whole-cell coverage over root-isolating cells, left-limit jumps and gaps. Define a justified stopping/width criterion before any isolation run.

Prove the chosen positive Bernstein3 or alternative positive representation on the refined cells. Extrema splitting and nonnegative values alone must not be cited as the R13 Bernstein2 lemma for a cubic. Additional inflection splitting or a different enclosure construction is a separate obligation.

Derive signed exponential degree3 weights, outward argument/weight/tail bounds and their behavior on algebraic or interval cell lengths. Reusing the R13 degree2 coefficients is not a completed derivation.
Derive closed-cell E majorants and ideal-comparison monotonicity while preserving global R history and all endpoint-limit conventions.
Complete independent proof review and necessary literature comparison before proposing scientific adoption. No negative theorem follows from a missing proof or input.
proposed_code_contract: Choose one explicit representation for cubic coefficients, algebraic extrema and rational isolating intervals.
Implement exact discriminant/sign decisions, repeated-root and endpoint cases, and finite termination with an honest unresolved/resource status.
Authenticate raw source/whole-forcing identities and keep arithmetic-control versus physical-certificate status separate.
Define resource precharge for overlap moments, root isolation, refinement, algebraic/rational bit growth and interval operations before executing them.
Prepare separate reference logic with independently frozen precision/guard and exact polynomial/root controls; do not import production/predecessor runners.
Fix accepted input sizes, output enclosure semantics, executable paths/hashes, commands, attempts and preservation of original failures before running.
required_rejection_controls: Missing quadratic whole-domain premise or nonnegativity certificate.
Quadratic source fed into R13 affine API by relabeling/interpolation.
Uncertified or overlapping root-isolating intervals, ambiguous root ordering or endpoint conventions.
Undecided discriminant/sign represented as a decided root absence.
Negative positive-basis coefficient accepted without a valid replacement enclosure.
Root-isolation/bit/cell/work/CPU/wall limit exceeded or tolerance enlarged after failure.
New run charged to exhausted R13 or older allowance.
